summary: Stock CHIRP ft60 driver (no OEM CPS to fetch: Yaesu ADMS-1J and RT Systems are paid). _download polls 10 x 8 bytes then raises RadioNoResponse; diagnostics show no partial data. NewChirp's hint told the user to stay on the F8 CLONE screen but not to press [F/W], which is what puts the FT-60 into CLONE.
